symbols.name: synthetic root of unity
symbols.meaning: The root of unity $\rho = y^{2r/q}$ of order $q$, whose powers index the transforms.
symbols.quote: Let $\rho = y^{2r/q}$, the synthetic root of unity of order $q$, so that $\rho^q = 1$.

symbols.name: forward transform
symbols.meaning: The forward synthetic transform, which maps an array of records to its frequency entries.
symbols.quote: Let $T$ be the forward transform, $T(a)_\ell = \sum_j a_j\rho^{j\ell}$, and let $S$ be the opposite transform, $S(X)_k = \frac{1}{q}\sum_\ell X_\ell\,\rho^{-k\ell}$, which uses the inverse root $\rho^{-1}$ and divides by $q$.

symbols.name: opposite transform
symbols.meaning: The opposite synthetic transform, which uses the inverse root and divides by $q$, mapping frequency entries back to records.
symbols.quote: Let $T$ be the forward transform, $T(a)_\ell = \sum_j a_j\rho^{j\ell}$, and let $S$ be the opposite transform, $S(X)_k = \frac{1}{q}\sum_\ell X_\ell\,\rho^{-k\ell}$, which uses the inverse root $\rho^{-1}$ and divides by $q$.

symbols.name: frequency index
symbols.meaning: The index of a frequency, running from 0 to q-1, that labels an entry of a transform.
symbols.quote: The index $\ell$ runs from $0$ to $q-1$ and labels the frequency of an entry.

symbols.name: pointwise product
symbols.meaning: The entrywise product of two arrays of records in the ring.
symbols.quote: Here $\odot$ multiplies two arrays entrywise in the ring.

symbols.name: index offset
symbols.meaning: The offset $i+j-k$ of a pair of indices $(i,j)$ from the target index $k$.
symbols.quote: where $p = i+j-k$ is the offset of a pair $(i,j)$ from $k$.

relations.quote: Convolution over the polynomial ring takes its records from the [Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1](polynomial-ring-mod-yr-plus-1.md), in which $y^r = -1$.
Convolution over the polynomial ring computes its transforms with [Synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md), so the transforms need only signed shifts and additions.

Convolution over the polynomial ring computes its products with [Signed coefficient packing](signed-packing.md), which turns each record product into one integer product, computed by the [established $O(n\log n)$ multiplier](established-multiplier.md).
Convolution over the polynomial ring is the [cyclic product](cyclic-convolution.md) of two arrays of records, and it is the step that convolves the axes left after the earlier reductions.
